SourceRequirements: Modify copies the actual selected existing event into temporary context before opening Type.
Same category Type -> Parameters -> Repeat for conditions; Type -> Parameters/Finish for actions.
No-page condition types still visit Repeat; no-page actions finish from Type.
Same-type selection retains imported values; changed type uses original explicit defaults.
Back stores submitted parameters; condition Repeat Back/Finish stores repeat.
Only Finish saves temporary event into the same identity, links and collection position.
CHANGESQUARE rectangle choice is disabled while modifying an existing event.
Action/condition temporary context persists in the enclosing selection dialog and feeds subsequent creation.
Reopening Modify replaces that category temporary value from the selected live event.
ModernRequiredGuards: One atomic live Undo includes type, parameters, repeat, explicit Save cleanup and nested alias edits.
Cancel keeps all live map bytes/history unchanged; only submitted temporary values may be remembered.
Preserve opaque bytes, identities, all links, scopes, headers and unrelated records.
Restrict changed type by every linked scope; do not guess unknown imported type layouts.
Private field commits and metadata revisions invalidate precomputed plans.
Live edit/Undo/raw mutation/foreign owner/resource reconfiguration/close invalidate old authority.
EN/RU translation retains pending page inputs and actual choices.
